advisory_findings.observed_technical_signal: HTTP 200 on https://star.dpdpa.support; 19 privacy/legal notice link(s) detected in DOM (https://star.dpdpa.support/security.html, https://star.dpdpa.support/).
advisory_findings.statutory_mapping: DPDP Act, 2023 Section 5(1) read with DPDP Rules, 2025 Rule 3 (Itemised Notice in clear and plain language)
advisory_findings.reputation_safe_advisory_note: The website surfaces 19 accessible privacy/legal notice link(s) in the DOM. To strengthen Rule 3 readiness, ensure the notice presents an itemised inventory of personal data categories and specific processing purposes at every data collection point.
advisory_findings.recommended_engineering_fix: Ensure every page footer and data collection form includes a prominent, static HTML anchor link to an itemised Section 5 / Rule 3 Privacy Notice with multi-language support (Eighth Schedule languages).
advisory_findings.verification_method: Run a read-only curl/DOM check on the landing page and verify `<a href="/privacy">` is present in the server-rendered HTML.

Under Rule 13(2), Significant Data Fiduciaries (and privacy-forward enterprises conducting proactive DPIAs) are encouraged to document the purpose, behavioral profiling scope, and consent binding of all tag managers, CRM trackers, session replay tools, and conversational widgets.

advisory_findings.statutory_mapping: DPDP Act, 2023 Section 8(5) read with DPDP Rules, 2025 Rule 6 (Reasonable security safeguards, encryption in transit, access controls) and Rule 8(3) (1-year minimum security log retention)
advisory_findings.reputation_safe_advisory_note: All primary HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options) are present on star.dpdpa.support, supporting robust transport and browser-side script isolation under Rule 6.
advisory_findings.recommended_engineering_fix: Configure edge CDN/web server responses to include Strict-Transport-Security (max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains), a restrictive Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, alongside 1-year security log retention (Rule 8(3)).
advisory_findings.verification_method: Run `curl -sI https://star.dpdpa.support` and confirm all recommended security headers are returned with HTTP 200.
